note: Three separate grass landings off Akersville Road, 0.8 (C), 1.05 (D) and 1.3 (E) miles from US 30; the pin is on D. Each sits back in the woods at the end of its own grass two-track: about 70 to 80 m for D and E, about 40 m for C, with wheel ruts showing on D's track in imagery. DCNR sizes D and E for two camper trailers and C for one, and says of all three 'Access road is a little rough, but site is secluded from road'. Nothing is hardened, so the driveways and landings will be soft after rain. Back-in. Akersville Road is gravel. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
